notes.title: Patch Notes ver. 25.27.d
notes.content:
[p]Hi there!

It’s Patch Notes time and this is a [b]BIG ONE[/b]! The team has been reading your feedback and, while no, they won’t bring a personalized pizza to your door, they have been updating and adding features you’ve been requesting![/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Significant UI/UX updates[/b] that surface enemy information in real-time[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced Inspect Mode[/b] that delivers more complete information on enemy and player status[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overhauled UX in the loadout screen[/b] for improved readability[/p][/*][*][p]Minor [b]change to Shop interface[/b] when purchasing an item from Fugitoid[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]These go along with some bug fixes and general improvements designed with your satisfaction and comfort in mind!*

Also, if you’re here and you haven’t checked out Tactical Takedown yet, well guess what? It’s on sale at 20% off! [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3229100/Teenage_Mutant_Ninja_Turtles_Tactical_Takedown/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We’ve got some more updates for you down the line, but until then…

See you on the internet,   

Chris @ Strange Scaffold.     

* We can’t really say we had [i]you[/i] in mind personally. But we had a general “community” in mind, which you are a part of! The community of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tactical Takedown players, or “Tac-take Turtz” as we’re known.** 

** This isn’t true, we’re not known as this. Unless this starts a “[i]thing[/i]”.*** 
[/p][p]*** It won’t, right?[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes: ver. 25.24.b
notes.content:
[p]Hi there!

That's right, it's Patch Notes! This time it's for [b]ver. 25.23.a[/b], which was weirdly the name of my first pet.*[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Switching save slots now shows a notification that confirms you have changed slots,[/p][/*][*][p]More clear which save slot is selected,[/p][/*][*][p]Loadout screen show what is currently being selected in a more overt way, highlighting the currently selected menu item,[/p][/*][*][p]Equipped actions and base kits now have a check mark next to them,[/p][/*][*][p]Navigation within the Loadout screen on controller is now more fluid and predictable,[/p][/*][*][p]Updated localization credits[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]These go along with some bug fixes, which, thank you by the way for reporting! If you find any, be sure to let us know about them so we can get 'em fixed!

See you on the internet, 

- Chris @ Strange Scaffold


* This isn't true, my real first pets were four goldfish called Leonardo, Donatello, Raphael, and Michelangelo so the truth it's still on point. [/p]

notes.title: Our Demo is OUT NOW for Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! 

That's right, the very first demo for Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tactical Takedown is [b]LIVE[/b] for Steam Next Fest!

The demo features a short tutorial and a modified version of the game's first chapter, so you'll get to experience a taste of what the full game will bring! 

The team has been COOKING on this game, and we are happy you can try a slice right now. Be sure to add the game to your wishlist if you haven't already done so and you'll know the second the game releases.

See you on the internet, 

- Strange Scaffold.
